title: Legal Consultant Registration
description: Complete registration form for legal consultants joining the ICJ empanelled panel.

fields.name: consultant_type
fields.label: Consultant Type
fields.helpText: Are you an in-house consultant employed by an organisation, or an independent consultant?

fields.name: organization_name
fields.label: Organisation Name
fields.helpText: Name of the organisation you are employed with as a legal consultant.

fields.name: experience_years
fields.label: Years of Experience
fields.helpText: Total years of legal consulting experience.

fields.name: rate_per_hour
fields.label: Consultation Rate (₹/hour)
fields.helpText: Your indicative hourly consultation rate in Indian Rupees (optional).

fields.name: university
fields.label: University / Institution
fields.placeholder: e.g., National Law School of India University
fields.helpText: Name of the university or institution that awarded your degree.

fields.name: passing_year
fields.label: Year of Passing
fields.helpText: Year in which you passed your highest law degree.

steps.stepDescription: Your areas of legal expertise and advisory sectors.

fields.name: expertise_domains
fields.label: Expertise Domains
fields.helpText: Select all legal domains in which you provide consulting services.

fields.name: advisory_sectors
fields.label: Advisory Sectors
fields.helpText: Industry sectors in which you have provided legal advisory services (optional).

fields.name: certifications
fields.label: Professional Certifications / Bar Memberships
fields.placeholder: List any professional certifications, specialised courses, or bar memberships you hold...
fields.helpText: Mention any relevant certifications or bar memberships that support your expertise (optional).

steps.stepDescription: Upload required documents to verify your professional credentials.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Passport-size Photograph
fields.helpText: Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPG or PNG, max 2 MB).

fields.name: qualification_certificate
fields.label: Qualification Certificate
fields.helpText: Upload your highest law degree certificate (PDF, JPG or PNG, max 5 MB).

fields.name: identity_proof
fields.label: Identity Proof
fields.helpText: Upload a government-issued identity document (PDF, JPG or PNG, max 5 MB).
